page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Centred title block at the upper middle, a printer's device (crown above a cross-shaped emblem with ribbon lettering) below it, and a short imprint at the lower middle.
page.notes: Title page with a printer's device (crown over a cross-shaped emblem with ribbon motto) in the centre. The scan is heavily stained, and strong show-through from the reverse side makes most lines unreadable; mirrored text from the other side has been left out. Only the word COSMOGRAPHIA and the imprint line at the foot are partly legible; the other lines are marked illegible. No running head, page number, catchword or signature is visible.
